claims.claim: S006-T16: In the stated finite total-dimension-at-most-three pure-degree meet-exact three-cover square with identically zero integral d2, existence for arbitrary free abelian A,B is equivalent to joint lower delta_A split injection AND graph-admissible B (split bottom maps and primitive upper amalgam).

If ker delta_C is torsion-free then lambda_K is primitive.
claims.scope: S006/MATHEMATICS: cellular top-degree saturation, natural MV and short exact sequence; full general B realization not obtained.
